page.content:
Seven-time champion of McLaren youth and Mercedes hybrid years.

How Lewis Hamilton connects

  • Faction: Mercedes-AMG Petronas — Lewis Hamilton won six of his seven titles with Mercedes.
  • Item: World Drivers' Championship — Hamilton matched Schumacher on seven World Drivers' Championships.
  • Character: Max Verstappen — Verstappen took the 2021 title from Hamilton on the last lap in Abu Dhabi.
  • Event: British Grand Prix — Hamilton's home grand prix is the British Grand Prix at Silverstone.

What is Lewis Hamilton?

Lewis Hamilton matched Schumacher's seven Drivers' Championships, winning first with McLaren and then as the face of Mercedes' hybrid era, with a record haul of race wins.

Key threads lead to Mercedes-AMG Petronas, World Drivers' Championship, Max Verstappen and British Grand Prix.
